clips.send: 1949, Crossing the Yangtze. On 21 April 1949 a million PLA troops crossed the river on a front from Jiangyin to Hukou. On 23 April they took Nanjing: the KMT’s reactionary rule collapsed. The New Democratic Revolution was won — the People’s Republic of China would be founded on 1 October 1949.

clips.send: 1931–1937, Japan invades. On 18 September 1931 Japan attacked Shenyang — the September 18th Incident began China’s partial resistance. On 12 December 1936 Zhang Xueliang and Yang Hucheng staged the Xi’an Incident; its peaceful settlement basically ended the civil war. On 7 July 1937 the Marco Polo Bridge Incident began the nation-wide War of Resistance.

clips.send: 1945–1947, The War of Liberation begins. After the Chongqing negotiations (1945), the KMT attacked the Central Plains Liberated Area in June 1946 — full-scale civil war. In summer 1947 the Liu–Deng army thrust into the Dabie Mountains, raising the curtain on the strategic counter-offensive.

clips.send: 1948–1949, The three great campaigns. Liaoshen (Northeast, around Jinzhou), Huaihai (centred on Xuzhou) and Pingjin (Beiping–Tianjin; Beiping was liberated peacefully). They basically destroyed the main force of the KMT army.

clips.send: 1921, The Communist Party of China is founded. In July 1921 the First National Congress opened in Shanghai; on the last day it moved to a boat on South Lake, Jiaxing. An epoch-making event: the Chinese revolution took on a new look.

clips.send: Ruijin. Nov 1931, Oct 1934. Red capital; the Long March begins. November 1931: the Provisional Central Government of the Chinese Soviet Republic was founded in Ruijin, Jiangxi, with Mao Zedong as chairman. The fifth counter-“encirclement” campaign failed because of the “Left” errors of Bo Gu, the Party’s leader at the time, and Otto Braun (Chinese name Li De), a military adviser sent from Moscow. October 1934: the main force of the Central Red Army was forced to leave the Central Revolutionary Base (from Ruijin, Yudu and other places) and began the Long March.

clips.send: 1935–1936, Victory of the Long March. Four crossings of the Chishui, across the Jinsha, the Dadu River and Luding Bridge, snow mountains and grasslands — in October 1935 the Central Red Army reached Wuqi. In October 1936 the three main forces met at Huining: the Long March ended in victory.

clips.send: 1919, The May Fourth Movement. At the Paris Peace Conference after World War I, Germany’s rights in Shandong Province were handed to Japan, not back to China. On 4 May students in Beijing rose up: “Fight for sovereignty abroad, punish traitors at home!” From June the centre moved to Shanghai and the working class became the main force.

clips.send: 1924–1927, Cooperation and the Northern Expedition. The KMT (Nationalist Party) held its First Congress in Guangzhou in 1924 and let Communists join: the first KMT–CPC cooperation. The Huangpu (Whampoa) Military Academy trained officers. In 1926 the Northern Expedition marched north to overthrow the warlords — until Chiang Kai-shek’s 1927 coup in Shanghai broke the alliance.

clips.send: 1934–1935, The Long March begins. After losing to the KMT’s fifth “encirclement” campaign, the Central Red Army left Ruijin in October 1934, broke four blockade lines at a terrible cost on the Xiang River, and turned to Guizhou. In January 1935 the Zunyi Conference became a life-or-death turning point.

clips.send: 1937–1945, The War of Resistance. Japan committed the Nanjing Massacre. Chinese forces fought back: Pingxingguan (1937), Taierzhuang (1938), the Hundred Regiments Offensive (1940). On 15 August 1945 Japan surrendered unconditionally; Taiwan returned to China. It was the first complete victory against foreign invasion in modern times.

clips.send: 1927, Armed struggle and Jinggangshan. On 1 August the Nanchang Uprising fired the first shot against the KMT reactionaries. The August 7th Meeting chose agrarian revolution and armed resistance. Mao Zedong led the Autumn Harvest Uprising troops to Jinggangshan — the first rural revolutionary base.

clips.send: Huining reunion. October 1936. The three main Red Armies meet: the Long March ends. October 1936: the Red First, Second and Fourth Front Armies met at Huining (Gansu) and Jiangtaibao (Ningxia). The Long March ended in victory. Significance: it preserved and tempered the core forces of the revolution and moved the revolution’s headquarters to the northwest. The Long March spirit: fearing no hardship, never giving up, putting the people’s interests first.

clips.send: Wuqi Town, northern Shaanxi. October 1935. The Central Red Army reaches northern Shaanxi. October 1935: the Central Red Army reached Wuqi Town in northern Shaanxi and joined the Shaanxi Red Army. Northern Shaanxi became the base of the Chinese revolution.

clips.send: 1919年 · 五四运动。中国在巴黎和会上外交失败。5月4日北京学生举行示威：“外争主权，内除国贼！”6月起运动中心转到上海，工人阶级成为主力。

clips.send: 1924—1927年 · 国共合作与北伐。1924年国民党一大在广州召开，标志第一次国共合作正式形成；创办黄埔军校。1926年北伐战争开始，目标是打倒帝国主义、推翻北洋军阀。1927年蒋介石发动四一二反革命政变，国民大革命失败。

clips.send: 1937—1945年 · 全民族抗战。日军制造南京大屠杀。中国军民英勇抗击：平型关大捷（1937）、台儿庄战役（1938）、百团大战（1940）。1945年8月15日日本宣布无条件投降，台湾回到祖国怀抱。这是近代以来中国反抗外敌入侵第一次取得完全胜利的民族解放战争。

clips.send: 1948—1949年 · 三大战役。辽沈战役（东北，攻克锦州）、淮海战役（以徐州为中心）、平津战役（北平和平解放）。三大战役基本上消灭了国民党军队的主力。

clips.send: 瑞金。1931年11月 · 1934年10月。红色故都，长征出发地。1931年11月，中华苏维埃共和国临时中央政府在江西瑞金成立，毛泽东任主席。由于博古、李德的“左”倾错误，第五次反“围剿”失败。1934年10月，中央红军主力被迫撤离中央革命根据地（从瑞金、于都等地出发），开始长征。

clips.send: 会宁会师。1936年10月。三大主力会师，长征胜利结束。1936年10月，红一、二、四方面军在甘肃会宁和宁夏将台堡胜利会师，长征胜利结束。意义：保存和锻炼了革命的基干力量，实现了中国革命大本营向西北的转移。长征精神：不怕任何艰难险阻，不惜付出一切牺牲，坚定理想信念，顾全大局、紧密团结。

clips.send: 1949年 · 渡江战役。1949年4月21日，百万解放军在西起湖口、东至江阴的战线上横渡长江；4月23日占领南京，统治中国22年的国民党政权覆灭。新民主主义革命取得伟大胜利——1949年10月1日，中华人民共和国成立。

clips.send: 1945—1947年 · 解放战争爆发。重庆谈判（1945）后，1946年6月国民党军队大举围攻中原解放区，全面内战爆发。1947年夏刘邓大军挺进大别山，拉开了战略反攻的序幕。

clips.send: 1931—1937年 · 日本侵华。1931年9月18日日军进攻沈阳，九一八事变标志中国局部抗战开始。1936年12月12日张学良、杨虎城发动西安事变，其和平解决使十年内战基本结束。1937年7月7日卢沟桥事变（七七事变），全民族抗战开始。

clips.send: 1927年 · 武装斗争与井冈山。8月1日南昌起义打响武装反抗国民党反动派的第一枪。八七会议确定土地革命和武装反抗的方针。毛泽东率秋收起义部队进军井冈山，建立第一个农村革命根据地。

clips.send: 1921年 · 中国共产党诞生。1921年7月，中共一大在上海召开，最后一天转移到浙江嘉兴南湖的游船上。这是开天辟地的大事变，中国革命从此焕然一新。
